## 3. 简要结论

- 成功 run 数：`40`（8 模型）；过关：`0`。
- 臂 `A20` 8 模型均值：Spec=0.464, Rec=0.625, BalAcc=0.545, Acc=0.579
- 臂 `A22` 8 模型均值：Spec=0.480, Rec=0.607, BalAcc=0.543, Acc=0.569
- 臂 `B1` 8 模型均值：Spec=0.548, Rec=0.552, BalAcc=0.550, Acc=0.549
- 臂 `B2` 8 模型均值：Spec=0.812, Rec=0.234, BalAcc=0.523, Acc=0.396
- 臂 `S1` 8 模型均值：Spec=0.450, Rec=0.629, BalAcc=0.540, Acc=0.577
- BalAcc Top5：
  - `eegnet/B1`：BalAcc=0.575, Spec=0.529, Rec=0.622, Acc=0.593
  - `conformer/B1`：BalAcc=0.574, Spec=0.457, Rec=0.691, Acc=0.623
  - `eegnet/A20`：BalAcc=0.571, Spec=0.423, Rec=0.719, Acc=0.632
  - `eegnet/A22`：BalAcc=0.568, Spec=0.439, Rec=0.697, Acc=0.621
  - `shallow/B1`：BalAcc=0.567, Spec=0.494, Rec=0.639, Acc=0.597
- 阈值扫描：val 选 τ 多抬 Rec、压 Spec，五折均值仍无法同时满足门控。
- 综合：八模型在 `merged_2s` 上，仅靠加权 CE / batch balance / SMOTE / 调阈值，**均未稳定达到** Spec≥0.40 且 Rec≥0.75 且 BalAcc≥0.65。
